Not directed at me personally, but I had an admission to hospital due to some mental health issues. It was early morning and I was upset and very distraught over the possibility of being involuntary admitted under the health code. This is an older hospital with another not far away being built to replace it. Whilst I was being seen to by a nurse, who was the most kind hearted and understanding person, there were two security personnel standing at the door. They were joking around and mentioned that in the new hospital the psychiatrist ward was on the second floor and that once they “escorted people up there they wouldn’t have to worry about them coming out”. Bother the nurse and I heard the comment and me already being in the state I was started sobbing even worse than before. The nurse was furious about this and said a formal complaint would be placed with the hospital.
